results.description:
Texas Hold'em poker is a popular and widely studied problem in the fields of Game Theory and Artificial Intelligence. Algorithms such as Tree Search, Regret Minimization, Reinforcement Learning and Neural Networks have been developed to solve poker. Nevertheless, solving multiplayer no-limit Texas Hold'em in real time remains a major challenge considering its vast combination of possible states and the existence of hidden information.

Based on Regret Minimization algorithms, we developed an innovative solving architecture that combines multi-stage Pre-training, Parallel Sampling, Equilibrium Finding, Dynamic Programming, State Abstraction, Encoding-Decoding and Edge Computing. Powered by our built-in AI engine, we present you Poker AI, a fast and accurate Texas Hold'em strategy solver that runs in real time on edge devices with limited computing resources.

We are also working on a neural network version of Poker AI using Self-playing, Reinforcement Learning and Deep Neural Networks, which may help avoid errors introduced by abstraction and encoding-decoding, and be more robust in long-tail scenarios that rarely occur. We will release the neural network version when its performance surpasses that of the regret minimization version in our evaluation tests.

Key Features of Poker AI:

·Offline and online poker with robots and human players.
Talk is cheap, the best way to improve your poker skills is simple and straight: play as much as you can! With Poker AI, you can start a game anytime, anywhere, with or without an internet connection, against bots or humans, and without risking any real money!

·Real-time strategy solver and win rate tools.
With our built-in AI engine, you can customize your poker scenarios and calculate strategies based on Nash equlibrium efficiently and intuitively. By combining pre-trained backbone strategies with edge computing optimizations, strategies and win rates for up to 10 players can be solved within seconds.

results.description:
Poker isn't a game of luck, and it isn't a game of tells. It's a game of decisions, and decisions can be taught.

Pokerly teaches no-limit Texas hold'em the way a language app teaches a language: short daily lessons, one idea at a time, each one tried on a real hand. Fifteen minutes a day, and in a month you're the player at the table who knows what they're doing.

START WHERE YOU ACTUALLY ARE
New to poker? Start with the first deal. Already play? A short level test puts you where your game is.

A COURSE BUILT IN ORDER
• Sit Down: how a hand runs, and what every move costs
• What Wins: nine kinds of hand, and which takes the pot
• Fold or Raise: the first decision of every hand
• Which Hands to Play: why a hand is worth opening, seat by seat
• Who Is at the Table: count the players, and wait for your hands
• Raised Pots and the Blinds: answer a raise, raise it again, defend the blind
Then the math, betting, reading players and keeping your money: eleven sections in all.

LEARN BY DECIDING, NOT BY READING
Every lesson is a real spot: cards, a pot, a stack and a decision to make. Choose, and find out at once why. Miss one and it comes back until it sticks.

YOUR OWN PREFLOP CHARTS
Start from a chart for every seat, paint in your own raises, calls and mixes, and drill them a few hands a day. The hands you get wrong come back sooner.

TABLES AGAINST THE BOTS
The course sits you down at tables as you go, and the Play tab has more: a six-handed table of regulars, or heads-up against a maniac who raises everything. A coach weighs in on your decisions. One Play table a day is free.

A GUIDE FOR EVERY UNIT
Each unit has a written guide: the theory in plain English, there whenever you want it.

A STREAK WORTH KEEPING
Play every day and the streak grows. Miss a day and a streak freeze can cover it.

ALL IN
Unlimited buy-ins, every section, your own preflop charts with drills, tables against the bots as often as you like, and practice built from your own mistakes. The yearly plan starts with a free trial.

NO REAL MONEY
There's no wagering here, no cash prizes and nothing to cash out. Chips are points. This is a course, not a casino.

Why bet? Why fold?

Every chart, solver and range tells you WHAT to do. None of them tell you WHY. LeakSeek is the GTO poker trainer built around the reasoning: learn the concept, drill it in real spots, then fix the leaks the app finds in your game.

HOW IT WORKS

Learn it. A chapter-by-chapter curriculum breaks down every idea behind a poker decision: equity, initiative, range advantage, blockers, board texture... Plain language you can use at the table.

Drill it. Play through 100,000+ solver-backed spots. Make your decision, find out if it was right, and get the reasoning behind it plus the full technical breakdown: ranges, EVs and frequencies.

Fix it. LeakSeek reads your game across 34 skills in 6 areas, shows you what is costing you the most, and builds targeted drills to train it out.

WHO IT IS FOR

LeakSeek Learn is for players who know the rules but not the game yet: too much contradictory advice, explanations that never quite land. Learn breaks down every concept and drills it until you are comfortable in the home game, at the low-stakes table, at the local casino.

LeakSeek Grind is for players already playing for money who want the level above: which combo to bluff, when to hero call, whether a range is capped. Grind takes you to a deep understanding of GTO play and lets you practice it seriously, so you can move up in stakes.

WHAT IS INSIDE

- A full curriculum: 24 concepts across 6 chapters, built by a professional player and tested by players at every level
- Three formats: cash, MTT and Spin & Go. Train the one you play, or all three
- A dedicated preflop trainer: see the ranges directly, skip postflop, rip through spots
- A leak profile that tracks 34 skills across 6 areas and turns them into a plan
- 100,000+ solver-backed spots, with instant reasoning after every hand

BUILT FOR FIVE MINUTES A DAY

Warm up before a session so you are sharp on hand one, not hand 40 of your third tournament. Put the commute to work. Play a few hands on a break and close the app: your progress saves itself. Instead of doomscrolling shorts, you could be learning GTO poker.

PRICING

Preflop+ is a poker math and preflop chart app for iPhone and iPad. It gives you Nash equilibrium shove/fold charts with the exact EV of every decision, five interactive training drills, and a full set of poker calculators — all working offline with no internet connection.

"Preflop+ is a great tool. It takes all the Nash Charts and distills them at your fingertips. It is far better than other apps as it displays EV of what each hand will be earning." — Matt Berkey, High Stakes Cash Game Pro and Founder, Solve For Why Academy

"I use the app every single day to improve my ability to quickly calculate pot odds and equity situations — invaluable in the live setting." — Lara Eisenberg, WSOP Bracelet Winner

WHY EXACT EVs MATTER

Most shove/fold apps give you a binary answer: shove or fold. That's fine at the extremes and useless at the margin. Preflop+ shows the actual EV of every hole card for shove, call, rejam, and call-rejam, so you can see which spots are genuinely close. When you have an edge on the table, you can pass on a marginally +EV shove. When you're short and card-dead, you can find the spots that are barely profitable and take them. The number tells you what the label can't.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• Nash Shove/Fold Charts — exact EVs for shove, call, rejam, and call-rejam across stack sizes from 5bb to 25bb and above, every position, and every player count
• Equity Calculator — hand vs hand, hand vs range, range vs range, on any street: preflop, flop, turn, and river
• Equity Drills — interactive quizzes to sharpen equity estimation for fast decisions in live games
• Pot Odds Trainer — practice pot odds calculation in realistic game scenarios
• Combinatorics Trainer — hand combinations and blocker effects, including how many combos of each hand type exist on a given board
• Custom Range Builder — create, save, and drill your own ranges for OPEN, CALL, 3-BET, 4-BET and more, with chart overlays
• Poker Math Calculators — MDF, geometric sizings, and other fundamentals for study sessions

WHO IT'S FOR

• Tournament players working on short-stack shove, fold, and rejam decisions
• Cash players who want to understand preflop EV rather than memorize charts
• Live players building pot odds and equity math for real-time decisions at the table
• Anyone who wants a complete preflop toolkit that works with no signal

EVERYTHING WORKS OFFLINE

No internet connection is needed for any feature. Charts, calculators, and drills all run on your device, so results are instant whether you're at a live table, on a plane, or in a casino with no reception.

Part of the ThinkGTO poker training suite, alongside Solver+, Postflop+, GTO Ranges+, PLO+, Battle+, and Tracker+ — used by over 15,000 active players.
